basic_profile.bio: A dedicated Naruto fan and anime enthusiast hailing from Southern California. I've been diving into the world of anime since my teens, and Naruto has always held a special place in my heart. When I'm not catching up on the latest episodes or dissecting jutsu mechanics, I work as a graphic designer for a tech startup. I’m currently single, and I enjoy spending my late evenings online, which is when I'm most active on Reddit. I have a penchant for discussing character development and exploring fan theories.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have an extensive background in anime and manga, primarily self-taught through years of watching and reading. My expertise also extends to graphic design, where I've honed my skills through both formal education and practical experience in the tech industry.
